create_inference_batcher: create an InferenceBatcher with a predict unit, max batch size, and thread concurrency backend
use_inference_batcher_context_manager: use the InferenceBatcher as a context manager to auto shutdown the executor on exit
access_batch_predict_unit: access the cached batch_predict_unit property to get a BatchServerPredictUnit from the InferenceBatcher
shutdown_inference_batcher: call shutdown on the InferenceBatcher to stop the thread pool executor and clean up resources
get_concurrency_backend: get a ThreadPoolExecutor concurrency backend for running ASE calculations concurrently
